tools.name: run
tools.description: Hand a lesson's run sheet to the teacher's lesson strip. In that lesson each task is a bar on a card above the prompt; the first starts with the lesson and each follows on as the one before runs out (a tick a mark for a quiz), with a soft chime. Checked against their timetable: the class must be on it at that date and period. Handing over the same lesson again replaces it.

children: No timetable at /Timetable.md: type /lessons timetable and the path of your timetable file.
